claims.claim: Discover Network's rulebook is the 'operating regulations and related program documents', which govern its direct merchant services agreements; the documents themselves are not published publicly.
claims.quote: The terms of Discover Network's direct merchant relationships are set forth in merchant services agreements, which are governed by our operating regulations and related program documents.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Filed before the Capital One acquisition closed on 2025-05-18. No public URL, edition or page count for the operating regulations found anywhere.

claims.claim: Discover publishes updates to its program documents (the mandate/release cadence) on a semi-annual basis, or more often when needed.
claims.quote: we publish updates to our program documents on a semi-annual basis or more frequently as needed.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Pre-acquisition filing. Consistent with an April/October release cycle but the 10-K does not name the months.

claims.claim: Compliance with the operating regulations, including data security standards and prohibited-activity rules, is enforced by designated Discover Global Network personnel.
claims.quote: Designated Discover Global Network personnel are responsible for validating compliance with laws and with our operating regulations, including enforcing our data security standards
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Discover Global Network is a founding member of the PCI Security Standards Council and pushes PCI standards adoption globally for merchants and service providers.
claims.quote: Discover Global Network is a founding and current member of the Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council, LLC
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Discover's dispute framework is a chargeback model: a dispute resolved for the cardholder is charged back to the merchant or merchant acquirer, with Discover bearing the loss if it cannot collect.
claims.quote: If a dispute is resolved in the customer's favor, we will cause a credit or refund of the amount to be issued to the customer and charge back the transaction
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Pre-acquisition filing. Merchant chargeback losses stated as not material for 2022 to 2024. The named dispute rules document (Dispute Rules Manual) is behind the Discover Network Disputes Portal login.

claims.claim: The named security programme is DISC (Discover Information Security and Compliance), under which merchants, acquirers, their merchants, service providers and agents must be PCI DSS compliant at all times.
claims.quote: The Discover Information Security & Compliance (DISC) program was developed to implement and maintain efficient data security requirements and procedures for its partners
claims.title: Discover Information Security and Compliance | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Page states 'must comply with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) at all times'.

claims.claim: Beyond PCI DSS, DISC requires every new merchant or agent payment application implementation to comply with the PCI Secure Software Standard.
claims.quote: Discover Network requires that each new implementation of payment applications by Merchants and their Agents is compliant with the Payment Card Industry Secure Software Standard.
claims.title: Discover Information Security and Compliance | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Same requirement is restated for acquirers, acquirer processors, merchant processors and sponsored merchants.

claims.claim: Contactless mobile (COTS) acceptance solutions must meet PCI MPoC, CPoC and SPoC standards, tied to D-PAS and D-PAS Connect certification requirements.
claims.quote: Discover Network requires contactless mobile solutions to be compliant with applicable MPoC, CPoC, and SPoC standards in accordance with D-PAS and D-PAS Connect certification requirements.
claims.title: Discover Information Security and Compliance | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Issuers may pick their own card production vendors if compliant with PCI Card Production Logical and Physical Security Requirements.

claims.claim: Discover runs a Security Compliance Innovation Program (SCIP) that grants merchants PCI DSS reporting relief if at least 75% of transactions use EMV/D-PAS chip, P2PE or EMVCo tokenization and other criteria are met.
claims.quote: Discover Network has implemented a merchant Security Compliance Innovation Program (SCIP) by which Discover Network merchants are able to obtain relief from providing PCI Compliance documentation
claims.title: Validation and Reporting Requirements | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Application PDF at /content/dam/discover/en_us/dgn/docs/merchant-security-compliance-innovation-program-application.pdf is 2 pages, marked Confidential and Proprietary, copyright 2026 DFS Services LLC. Acquired merchants go through their acquirer.

claims.claim: Merchant PCI validation is annual: a PCI DSS AOC is due one year from the prior validation, with Level 1 requiring a QSA on-site assessment and Levels 2 and 3 an SAQ, plus quarterly ASV scans.
claims.quote: The due date to report your PCI DSS compliance to Discover Network is one year from the date of prior compliance validation.
claims.title: Validation and Reporting Requirements | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Breached merchants may be forced to validate at a higher level; non-compliance fees are mentioned as a consequence of breach.

claims.claim: Service providers (acquirers, processors, payment enablers, gateways) are tiered at 300,000 Discover transactions per year: Level 1 needs an annual QSA on-site assessment, Level 2 an SAQ D.
claims.quote: All Service Providers that store, process and/or transmit over 300,000 Discover Network card transactions per year.
claims.title: Service Provider Compliance | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: All service providers must submit a PCI compliance report every year.

claims.claim: Acquirers are periodically surveyed by Discover on their compliance with the Acquirer Operating Regulations and their merchant portfolio, and are responsible for administering DISC for their merchants.
claims.quote: Acquirers will be asked by Discover Network on a periodic basis to answer a short list of questions regarding Acquirer Operating Regulation and Merchant Portfolio compliance
claims.title: PCI Acquirer Compliance | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Names 'Acquirer Operating Regulation' as a distinct document; not published publicly. Quote drops the registered mark after Discover.

claims.claim: The High Brand Risk (HBR) Program imposes enhanced registration and operating requirements on acquirers for verticals such as online gambling, skill games and digital currency, with non-compliance fees for failure to register merchants.
claims.quote: HBR manages the elevated risk of specific transaction verticals like online gambling, skill-based games, and digital currency via enhanced registration and operating requirements.
claims.title: High Brand Risk (HBR) Program | Discover Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: FAQ: 'Failure to do so may result in non-compliance fees' and 'an acquirer must follow the requirements described in the program documents and operating regulations'. No registration fee at this time. HBR portal enrolment at servicecenter.discovernetwork.com/portalenroll/enrollmentform/.

claims.claim: The Fraud and Risk Center login page names the gated partner portals: EASI for acquirers, acquirer processors and issuers, Advanced Payments Providers, Discover eCentral for merchants and the Discover Network Disputes Portal.
claims.quote: Acquirers, Acquirer Processors and Issuers Log into the EASI Portal or Join Now Advanced Payments Providers Log in or Join Now Discover eCentral Merchants Log in
claims.title: Fraud and Risk Center Log In
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Also lists enrolment for Account Incident Manager, Confirmed Fraud, Fraud Alerts and High Brand Risk, and states MFA has been added. Page footer still reads DFS Services LLC.

claims.claim: Capital One's first post-acquisition 10-K groups Discover Network, PULSE, Diners Club and Network Partners as the 'Global Payment Network' but contains no reference to operating regulations, network rules or PCI.
claims.quote: the Discover Network, the PULSE Network, Diners Club International ("Diners Club") and Network Partners (collectively, the "Global Payment Network")
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Text search of the full filing for 'operating regulations', 'network rules', 'PCI' and 'Payment Card Industry' returned zero hits; the rulebook cadence disclosure from the Discover 10-K was not carried over.

claims.claim: Discover Network's SCIP application form is still issued under DFS Services LLC with a 2026 copyright, showing the pre-acquisition legal entity continues to publish partner compliance documents after the Capital One deal.
claims.quote: Confidential and Proprietary | (c) 2026 DFS Services LLC
claims.title: Merchant Security Compliance Innovation Program (SCIP) Application
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: PDF, 2 pages, read with pypdf. The copyright symbol is rendered here as (c).

claims.claim: The Discover Network Disputes Portal and Discover eCentral are the named dispute and merchant servicing surfaces, both behind login.
claims.quote: Discover eCentral Merchants Log in Discover Network Disputes Portal Log in
claims.title: Fraud and Risk Center Log In
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: No public dispute rules, reason-code list or timeframes found on any open page.
